summary.intent: Triage and drive a batch of open PRs (#596, #599-#605, release #558) in the callisto repo to green CI and merge-ready state, coordinating multiple Claude sessions, and clean up finished sessions and old worktrees.
summary.outcome: Fixed #601's fuzz-target CI break; #596, #600, #601, #602 merged; #603's finding fixed and synced; #604 synced with main; new #605 opened; 18 finished sessions and 33 old worktrees removed (226 GB to 27 GB). #603, #604, #605 await CI and approval; #599 and release PR #558 remain.

repo: Public signature changes in the model or manifests crates can break fuzz targets (e.g. fuzz/fuzz_targets/manifest_editor.rs); `just fuzz-check` catches this and was added to the rule sheet.
Most red CI marks are Entire approval gates or open Entire findings, not real failures; real failures must be separated out per PR.
Commits must not carry Claude-Session trailers/session links per repo rules; the auto-mode classifier also blocks them.
The --dry-run check must run before artifact-directory resolution in build-python/pack-npm/package-cargo so a missing dir yields E309, not E213.
durable_release_e2e tests fail locally in the sandbox because registry.npmjs.org is blocked; leave to CI.
Changesets groups containing `!`, `{`, `[`, `(` are not auto-translated; callisto prints a paste block for review. Names are resolved via the npm name.

code.finding: Fuzz call site needed updating after a public signature change in #601; fixed and verified with `just fuzz-check`.

workflow: `claude rm <id>` removes the session's worktree; check each worktree for uncommitted/unpushed work first.
Locked worktrees needed the double force flag to remove.
Splitting queued tasks into separate sessions (e.g. #604 into its own) avoids waiting behind other work.
A background watcher over sessions and PRs, re-launched after each notification, is useful for tracking state changes.
Verify peer-session claims (signed head SHAs, ls-remote, Entire findings) before reporting them.

friction: Only 3 of 18 `claude rm` calls reported removal at first; the rest needed inspection of output and flags.
15 worktrees were locked and required double force removal.
Sandbox blocked npm registry, causing an unrelated local test failure.
Auto-mode classifier blocked a commit containing a session trailer.
Missed fuzz-check initially let #601 break CI.
open_items: Remove redundant `homepage` keys (plan item A) in the next small PR.
Decide on `agent-a5e8056f1ada4a831` (1 unpushed commit) and `wp-e-native-name` (171 uncommitted changes); user hasn't yet asked to see them.
Remove `cleanup-597` and `wp-git-boundary-types` worktrees after their running sessions finish.
Release: merge #599 (PyPI empty token), then release PR #558.
Unused workspace `tracing` dependency is handled by #603 per the earlier note.
